p.hi: Agreement for the Application of the Modus Vivendi of 7th May, 1919

div.p:
As regards the application of paragraph 3 of the modus vivendi of the 7th May, 1919, it is stated:— 1.
That the total of 6,500 tons coke is to be understood of deliveries from the mines in unoccupied territory of Lorraine, the Saar and Luxemburg and is to be per day. 2.
That deliveries of coke by water shall be included in the sum total of the deliveries of coke in exchange for minette.
The unoccupied territories will furnish per day to Alsace-Lorraine and the occupied territories a total of 12,500 tons of coal.

The occupied territories will send to the unoccupied territories:— (a)
80,000 tons of raw lignite per month. (b)
50,000 tons of lignite briquettes per month.

If the deliveries of coal provided for in paragraph 2 above fall below 375,000 tons per month, the total of 50,000 tons of lignite briquettes
can be reduced in the ratio of 7 tons of briquettes for every 5 tons of coal in deficit.

quote.p: (c) 1,000 tons of Saar coal per day. This quantity of 1,000 tons will be increased by 400 tons for each 1,000 tons of coke received over and above the total of 6,500 tons.

div.p: The balance of deliveries effected on one side and the other will be made for each of the quantities listed above at the latest on the 15th of each month for the previous month, and the party whose deliveries show a deficit must make up the deficit in the deliveries of the following month.
